tiktok_title: Bayi udah melek, terus mainin apa? Contekan ide main sesuai usia
caption:
Wake window itu waktu melek di antara dua tidur. Diisinya nggak perlu mainan mahal: ngobrol, tengkurap di lantai, cilukba, masukin balok ke wadah. Kamu tetap mainan favoritnya.

Menjelang tidur, ganti yang tenang: lampu redup, baca buku atau nyanyi pelan. Main yang heboh taruh di awal waktu melek.

Tengkurap cuma pas melek dan ditemenin. Tidurnya tetap telentang.

Bayimu paling suka main apa?

Sumber: CDC Learn the Signs. Act Early., AAP (healthychildren.org), Tresillian

sources: CDC Learn the Signs. Act Early., Milestones by 4 Months, what you can do: talk back to baby's sounds, play on the floor or a play mat every day, safe toys easy to hold like rattles or cloth books, read and sing. https://www.cdc.gov/act-early/milestones/4-months.html

CDC Learn the Signs. Act Early., Milestones by 9 Months, what you can do: peek-a-boo with a cloth, hide a toy under a blanket, dump blocks out of a container and put them back, my turn your turn with a toy, name pictures in books. https://www.cdc.gov/act-early/milestones/9-months.html
CDC Milestones by 2 Months (talk, read, sing. tummy time while awake and supervised) and by 18 Months (stacking blocks, push toys, books). https://www.cdc.gov/act-early/milestones/2-months.html

AAP healthychildren.org, Back to Sleep, Tummy to Play: tummy time only while the baby is awake and someone is watching. always on the back for sleep. https://www.healthychildren.org/English/ages-stages/baby/sleep/Pages/Back-to-Sleep-Tummy-to-Play.aspx

Tresillian, Responsive settling: a calm, predictable bedtime routine. routines should take no longer than 30 to 40 minutes. https://www.tresillian.org.au/media/0hdnauuu/tre-26_4331-tip-responsive-settling-12-months-to-toddler.pdf
